propositions: Complete end-to-end test suite must cover all failure modes (mixed success, transient recovery, long-delay deferral, permanent failure, auth/provider stop, fuse open/reset, label-first create, restart, partial outcome, delivery failure) without external credentials in credential-free verified-fake Cloud/DC environment
Route census and poison checks must verify no removed production fallback path is reachable and legacy paths are properly poisoned
ADR 0103 must document retry ownership, failure taxonomy (11->5 buckets), fuse/containment strategy, intentional deltas, expand/contract cutover, and no-remote-delete rollback guarantee
Rollback behavior must re-observe remote state and never delete successful Jira work on partial or failed outcomes
Architecture and operator documentation must define versioned outcomes, planner->coordinator->adapter dependency direction, and future adapter atomic-operation/retry obligations
All acceptance criteria validation tests (doc index, ADR numbering, route census, taxonomy coverage, portable E2E) must pass without external provider triggers
